en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an industrial building complex with a tall smokestack and adjoining residential-looking house. The scene is sparse, with open ground in the foreground and some fencing. The image has an old, worn border typical of early 20th-century postcards. There appears to be faint, handwritten text in the sky area but it's not clearly legible. On the building, faint signage can be seen, possibly with a Germanic or Central European word ending in 'HALLE' or 'HALLES'.
